# AK Enterprises

> AK Enterprises builds custom-built Business Operating Systems for service businesses across the UK, USA, and EU. We deploy infrastructures that capture leads, automate follow-ups, and run without the owner.

## About

AK Enterprises is a technology company that designs, builds, and deploys Business Operating Systems (BOS) for service-based businesses. Our systems integrate CRM, AI-powered follow-ups, automated bookings, review capture, and lead management into a single unified infrastructure.

## Services

- **Business Operating Systems**: End-to-end infrastructure for service businesses
- **AI-Powered Follow-Up**: Automated lead nurturing and customer engagement
- **CRM Deployment**: Custom CRM systems tailored to your workflow
- **Automated Bookings**: Integrated scheduling and calendar management
- **Review Capture Systems**: Automated review collection across platforms
- **Lead Management**: Intelligent lead routing and qualification

## Regions

We operate across:
- United Kingdom (London)
- United States (New York, Miami, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, Dallas, Atlanta, Minneapolis)
- United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi)
- Qatar (Doha)
- Romania
- European Union
